CommunityApplications.Profile:
Unraid templates for **Trident Studio**, a self-hosted slicer with a web UI, and **Holecraft**, a browser-based 3D modeller for makers. Trident Studio runs OrcaSlicer's slicing engine headless in Docker, so you can slice from any browser or phone, with OrcaSlicer's full printer and filament library built in and extra support for belt (conveyor) printers.
**Apps in this repository** - **Trident Studio**: the slicer and web UI. - **Holecraft**: offline 3D modelling in the browser, with resin tools (hollowing, drain holes, support points) that use Trident Studio.
**Support**: please open an issue at https://github.com/mugenoesis/Trident/issues (Trident Studio) or https://github.com/mugenoesis/holecraft/issues (Holecraft).
CommunityApplications.DonateText: Trident Studio is free and built in my spare time. If it helps you, you can support it on Ko-fi.
